backends.safety: Metals runs on the trace-managed JDK 21 from the pinned, sha256-locked jar set (argument file in the state folder) with its own short user home (Bloop socket) and COURSIER_MODE=offline: server parts for the repository's Scala versions (mtags / presentation compiler, SemanticDB, Bloop, sbt-bloop, compiler bridges) are fetched only by `trace status --install scala` into the tools folder and read from there. Importing the build (sbt bloopInstall, Bloop compiles) runs the project's build definition, so it needs `trace index --allow-build`; sbt runs offline (-Dsbt.offline=true) in batch mode without its server against the user's installed caches, inside trace's mirror of the repository. Bloop runs as a child of the Metals JVM and stops with the session's process tree; its daemon folder is below the short home on Linux / macOS and in the user's LocalAppData\ScalaCli on Windows (Windows answers that known folder from the user profile). A failed import is a build or dependency error at once; queries start after the first compile of the open files ended. The HTTP server, client commands, input boxes and icons are off; build-import prompts are answered only with Import build / Import changes / Connect / Reconnect.
